name: @alvintayzhenwei/kanban-lite
description: A lightweight local Kanban board for shared agent workflows

scripts.test: npm run build --silent && node --test dist/tests/domain/*.test.js dist/tests/http/*.test.js dist/tests/storage/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.format: prettier --write src adapters/mcp/src adapters/mcp/tests adapters/mcp/*.json tests public scripts *.json *.ts *.js .github README.md SECURITY.md docs plugins/shared
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src adapters/mcp/src adapters/mcp/tests adapters/mcp/*.json tests public scripts *.json *.ts *.js .github README.md SECURITY.md docs plugins/shared
scripts.check:mcp: eslint adapters/mcp/src && npm run typecheck --prefix adapters/mcp && npm run build --silent && npm test --prefix adapters/mcp

author: Alvin Tay Zhenwei
